Name: Greenhouse with Veranda
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere!
[/size][/color][color=#efefef][size=3]Replaces greenhouse with this Greenhouse with Veranda.
You can plant all over the dirt even behind glass, and giant crops are allowed. Water source in the pond and also in the veranda.
[size=3]
Installation: Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/size]

Can I install it in a saved game?
Yes, if you install it in a saved game maybe you will need this mod [/size][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move It[/url][color=#efefef][size=3] so you can move your crops or trees without losing anything.
